card.name: Punctuation after anticonvulsant class names
card.fires_on: The colon, comma, "e.g.," or "such as" that follows the word anticonvulsants (or anti-epileptic drugs) or an early drug in the list, just before the list names phenytoin or phenobarbital.

modes.label: Colon after class
modes.description: A colon or the end of the word anticonvulsants in an interaction table, right before the drug list.

modes.label: List openers and commas
modes.description: "e.g.," or "such as" or a comma inside a list of enzyme-inducing anticonvulsants, where phenytoin or phenobarbital comes next.
modes.example: Enzyme-inducing anticonvulsants such<< as>> phenytoin, primidone

card.writes: It pushes the model to write phenytoin or phenobarbital, drug names that begin with "phen", as the next item in the list.
card.plain: It fires at the point in an interaction list where an anticonvulsant drug such as phenytoin or phenobarbital is about to be named.
